name: Druck Analogeingang low and high
Pipe Size and Standard
func:
/*
When using the FD-G25: 0: --, 1: 1", 2: 3/4"
When using the FD-G50: 0: --, 1: 2", 2: 1 1/2", 3: 1 1/4"
When using the FD-G80: 0: --, 1: 3", 2: 2 1/2"
When using the FD-G125: 0: --, 1: 5", 2: 4"
When using the FD-G200: 0: --, 1: 8", 2: 6"

0: --
1: JIS(Japan)
2: ASTM(US)
3: DIN(Germany)
4: GB(China)
5: Other
*/
msg.payload = {
    'fc': 3,
    'unitid': 1,
    'address': 196,
    'quantity': 2
}
return msg;
